$comment: G4 dismissal rules (plan 4.6): structural accessibility nodes dismissed by a named rule. Schema of a rule: {"id": string, "controlType": string (UIA control type the rule applies to), "namePattern": optional regular expression on the node's label, "why": string}. An L01 observation names a rule in `dismissed_by`; validate.ts re-applies the rule's predicate and fails a dismissal it does not match. Ids are scripts/census/live/common.ts DISMISS_RULES (L01 pins them); the design D6a names are noted in each why. G4 compares controlType exactly, so the separator has two rules. No rule carries a namePattern: G4 tests it against label or object_name, and L01 writes no label on a dismissed line, so a pattern could only fail a correct dismissal. Main-owned.
